review: 2:2 שֶׁמֶן תּוּרַק — direct quotation of Song 1:3 ('שֶׁמֶן תּוּרַק שְׁמֶךָ'), which is why the Name and the oil are identified here.
3:1 מִגְדַּל־עֹז — Proverbs 18:10, where the verse reads 'מִגְדַּל־עֹז שֵׁם יְהוָה'; here it is applied to the Name of Jesus.
3:2 מִסְתּוֹר — biblical noun (Isa 4:6, Ps 32:7 סֵתֶר); 'a hiding place from all harm'.
4:4 הַמְקֻוָּה — pu'al participle of קוה, 'the awaited'; the root is biblical but this passive form is rare.
2:1 שְׁמוֹ שֶׁמֶן זָךְ וְטָהוֹר — the Arabic is 'اِسْمُهُ دُهْنٌ نَقِيّ' ('pure'); וְטָהוֹר makes the ritual-purity sense explicit and fills the line.
